Lisinopril-Ibuprofen.warning: May decrease kidney function and reduce BP control.
Lisinopril-Ibuprofen.clinical_guidance: NSAIDs inhibit renal prostaglandins, attenuating the hypotensive effect of ACE inhibitors and escalating the risk of acute renal failure.

Warfarin-Aspirin.warning: Severe compounding hemorrhagic risk; major bleeding hazard.
Warfarin-Aspirin.clinical_guidance: Synergistic anticoagulant and antiplatelet inhibition markedly increases incidence of gastrointestinal and intracranial hemorrhages.

Metformin-Contrast.warning: Increased risk of fatal lactic acidosis.
Metformin-Contrast.clinical_guidance: Iodinated radiocontrast media can impair renal filtration, causing metformin accumulation.

Sertraline-Tramadol.clinical_guidance: Dual serotonergic reuptake and release leads to excessive CNS serotonin stimulation.
